case_number: 2023INSC814; CIVIL APPEAL NO…….. OF 2023 (Arising out of SLP (C) No.15793 of 2014)
summary: Grounds for divorce under Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 Section 13; evolving interpretation of 'cruelty' as mental/physical; subjectivity based on social milieu, gender sensitivity; historical progression from fault theory to liberal construction; socio-economic vulnerability of women post-divorce; courts must apply 'social-context thinking' balancing equity, avoiding perpetuation of trauma; subjectivity in cruelty determination emphasized.
final_judgment: Leaves granted; matter remanded to lower court with directions for contextual, empathetic examination of cruelty claims considering socio-economic realities and gender perspective; no absolute decree issued at Supreme Court level.
